purpose: Define metadata-only calibration and alignment conditions for comparing air-quality observations across a sensor mesh. This manifest does not deploy sensors, collect live telemetry, access sites, issue public alerts, determine health risk, control infrastructure, or authorize external action.

non_authorization.statement: This manifest supports internal air-quality research calibration and comparison planning only. It does not authorize sensor deployment, site access, telemetry ingestion, public-health determination, public alerting, municipal action, infrastructure control, data transfer, or external action.

calibration_formula.comparison_rule: Mesh comparison requires declared pollutant class, reference method, co-location status, drift status, season, source proximity, uncertainty assessment, and aggregation method.
calibration_formula.interpretation_limit: The index is an internal calibration comparison value. It does not establish air quality truth, health status, regulatory compliance, exposure, municipal authority, public alert eligibility, or operational permission.

applicability_limitations: No reference method, co-location evidence, drift assessment, source-proximity adjustment, or aggregation method is recorded.
This placeholder stratum does not support a comparable mesh-level air-quality claim.
This record does not authorize sensor deployment, live data ingestion, public alerting, municipal action, or health determination.

privacy.minimum_disclosure_rule: Record only coarse or user-controlled calibration strata and reference metadata. Do not record personal identities, household exposure, health information, neural information, biometric information, device identifiers, private telemetry, precise private locations, credentials, or operational-system details.

revision_triggers: A pollutant class, reference method, co-location condition, drift assessment, season, source-proximity context, aggregation method, correlation assumption, or uncertainty contract changes.
A BRI calibration matrix condition or shared calibration-governance rule changes.
A mesh stratum is added, corrected, superseded, withdrawn, or structurally blocked.
A privacy, sensitive-location, public-alert, health, municipal-action, or non-authorization boundary changes.
